cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort

decision_rule: Strictly validate the second pass, then compare a deterministic union with the saved first pass. Discard other whenever either pass supplies a defined non-other type. Continue to a full consumed-development assessment only if all 120 second-pass rows are valid, unioned exact post-type sets reach at least 0.70, and unioned product-label exact sets do not fall below 0.85. A selected implementation must still pass a fresh unseen final cohort under unchanged floors.
global_stop: The transport refuses request seven and reserves worst-case bytes and output tokens before every call. There are no retries or fallback calls, and capacity cannot transfer to another lane, prompt, cohort, or provider.

prior_probe_results.explicit_type_checks: 120/120 valid but post-type exact sets fell from 76/120 to 56/120 and product-label exact sets from 102/120 to 96/120
prior_probe_results.high_effort_thinking: invalid after exhausting the first request's 16384-token output cap
prior_probe_results.low_effort_thinking: valid first batch but worse on both post types and product labels

reason: Both independent Flash reviewers were stable and their union crossed the locked exact-set floor, while one-pass candidates chiefly omitted secondary labels. This probe isolates a second production-shaped non-thinking pass before changing semantics or production call topology.
